name: Blueberry Protocol oracle-decimals market drain (c0ffeebabe pre-emption)
date_note: Protocol and press call it the "2/22/24 exploit" (US evening); the attack tx lands 2024-02-23 02:22 UTC.
verdict_reason: Attacker (EOA 0x0512ac94..., contract 0x70b96d02... deployed 02:18:11 UTC) broadcast its exploit tx 0xb6748899... to the public mempool; first seen 02:22:09.219 UTC (Chainbound), 1.78 s before slot 8485909. c0ffeebabe tx 0xf0464b01... is index 0 of block 19287289 (02:22:11), the block BEFORE the attacker tx (19287290, index 218, 02:22:23). The attacker tx still succeeded in the next block but received 0 of every token. Ordering evidence: both txs in consecutive blocks, attacker tx pending in public mempool at the time of the bot block; c0ffeebabe tx itself is private (not in mempool-dumpster csv or sourcelog). Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.
era: post-merge (mempool-dumpster + sourcelog + Flashbots relay bids all available)

protocol_loss_usd.reported: ~$1.3M drained, 366.6 ETH recovered, ~91 ETH (~$0.27M) paid to proposer

funding_tx.source_note: funder 0x1f381f47... not traced further (not checked whether CEX/Tornado); EOA is an older active wallet (46 txs Jan-Oct 2024+)

txs.note: wrap 1 ETH, Bank.enterMarkets-style call, mint 1 WETH collateral, borrow on OHM/USDC/WBTC markets: received 0 of each; the 1 ETH collateral stays minted (9,999,999,999 bWETH units)

bots.label: c0ffeebabe.eth

tx_public_facts.first_seen: none: private (absent from mempool-dumpster csv and sourcelog 2024-02-23)

captured.token: OHM, USDC, WBTC borrowed from Blueberry markets, swapped to WETH

bots.notes: Block 19287289 contains exactly 3 txs: the bot tx then two payouts from the builder fee recipient. No relay-independent evidence of who told the builder; builder bids that jump to 10.1 ETH start 45 ms after the attacker tx first-seen (contents of losing bids not public).

funds_fate.what: coinbase transfer from the bot tx to the block fee recipient (builder "Ty For The Block", pubkey 0x88cd924c...)
builder returns 80.1% to the Blueberry multisig, same block index 1
builder proposer-payment, same block index 2 = the winning bid value (19.9% of the loot) = the "validator payment"
bot contract returns leftover to bot EOA inside its tx (net of gas ~0.0464 ETH)
c0ffeebabe EOA sends 70 ETH to the Blueberry multisig (public mempool, first seen 03:41:09.350 UTC, block 19287679)
funds_fate.note: purpose not stated in any source seen; tx-level fact only

funds_fate.what: builder fee address sends residue to the multisig (block 19289339)

multisig forwards 366.55325034 ETH to 0x72d19f7c71a2bd5e61871b1d3df7a45ae5ec9582 after a 1 ETH test tx; lookalike addresses 0x72d1...9582 send dust to the multisig right after (address poisoning attempts)

proposer fee recipient 0x25b9eb08 forwards 98.168 ETH to 0x700d2cab... on 2024-02-24 05:00:11 UTC (block 19295216); no return of the 91.04 ETH to Blueberry seen in the multisig history to block 19300000

relays_answered.others: ultrasound, bloxroute-regulated, agnostic, aestus, titan, ethgas, btcs answered with 0 bids (retention); retired relays unreachable

value_escalation.note: baseline: ~0.11 ETH for the whole preceding 9 s

auction.value_escalation_note: Bid contents are not public; that these bids carry the 457.5 ETH coinbase payment is inferred from the value level (baseline ~0.11 ETH) and from the winning block's contents.
auction.builder_refund_note: no refund to the bot; builder instead returned 366.5068 ETH (80.1%) to the victim protocol multisig inside the same block

headline_text: c0ffeebabe.eth's tx took the full market cash (457.68 ETH) one block before the attacker's public tx landed, which then got nothing; the builder passed 366.5 ETH to Blueberry's multisig and c0ffeebabe's EOA later sent it 70 ETH.

harmonized.verdict_reason: c0ffeebabe.eth landed at position 0 of block 19287289. The attacker transaction was public from 02:22:09.219 UTC, landed in block 19287290 and received nothing.
